title: [WIP] Update action run logs for better clarity
body:
## Fix Changeset Workspace Error ✅

Successfully fixed the CI failure in the release workflow.

### Plan:
- [x] Investigate GitHub Actions failure
- [x] Identify the issue: changeset references non-workspace package
- [x] Remove `@objectstack/spec-monorepo` from the changeset file
- [x] Validate the fix by running `pnpm run version` locally
- [x] Commit and push the fix
- [x] Code review completed with no issues
- [x] Security scan completed with no issues

### Root Cause:
The changeset file `.changeset/migrate-to-tsup.md` incorrectly referenced `@objectstack/spec-monorepo`, which is the private root package of the monorepo, not a workspace package that can be published.

### Solution:
Removed the line `"@objectstack/spec-monorepo": patch` from the changeset file. The root package is marked as `"private": true` in `package.json` and should not be included in changesets.

### Verification:
- ✅ `pnpm run version` runs successfully without errors
- ✅ No other changeset files have the same issue
- ✅ Code review passed with no comments
- ✅ Security scan passed (no code changes to analyze)

The fix is minimal and surgical - only one line removed from the changeset file.
